validity.recommendation: Length 20.6 km is the Ukrainian section only; the drawn route is the whole 53 km corridor. Capacity 2 bcm/y is backed by two refs from the wiki page; the 1999 figure of up to 4 bcm/y was a planned delivery volume.
validity.researcher_notes: The pipeline is real. A December 1999 Interfax-Ukraine wire story and the Naftogaz history page both name the Khust-Satu Mare line, and the Romanian grid operator lists the matching Tekovo to Medies Aurit border point today. Length (20.6 km), diameter (720 mm) and start year (1999) match the wire story exactly. It is not a duplicate of any other row in the list: it is the only Ukraine to Romania line at Khust. It is correctly a gas transmission export line. Capacity checks out at 2 bcm/y. A 2009 East European Gas Analysis table and a 2012 Ekonomicheskie Izvestia table both give 2 bcm a year. The 1999 sources' up to 4 bcm a year was a planned delivery volume. Ownership at the border: the Ukrainian operator, with Ukrtransgaz as builder in 1999.

fills.researcher_notes: The sheet's 2 bcm a year is right, and these two refs back it. A January 2009 table from East European Gas Analysis lists Hust-Satu Mare at the Tekovo border station at 2 bcm a year on one line. A December 2012 Ekonomicheskie Izvestia article, reprinted by ukrrudprom, gives the same 2 for Khust-Satu Mare in its table of export pipelines. Both are cited on the pipeline's wiki page. The original East European Gas Analysis page is gone, so the ref is its archived copy. Two 1999 sources say the line would carry up to 4 bcm a year by 2010. That reads as a planned delivery volume, not the line's capacity, so it is not used. The Romanian grid operator gives 2.71 bcm a year for the Tekovo to Medies Aurit border point as a whole.

status_reviews.researcher_notes: Newest dated evidence is the English Wikipedia article on the Ukrainian grid, which covers 2023 and lists the line as a working export line. The Romanian grid operator page lists the Tekovo to Medies Aurit border point as live but is undated. I found no source from 2024 or later that says gas flowed through this line, and no source saying it is idle. No change is proposed and the sheet status is left as operating. Searched in Ukrainian, Russian and English.
